bias.zh: 反弹 · 守住 $920–947，仍低于 10 日均线

read.en: SanDisk fell 4.1% on Nov 12 to $937.46, trading $869.49–952.93. It is above the 5-day ($899.3) and below the 10-day ($969.3), 30-day ($1,287.9), 100-day ($1,512.1) and 200-day ($1,280.7); only the 200-day is rising. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 2, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($1,166.86), and RSI is 35.9.

The dip to $869.49 undercut the $920–947 support intraday, but the close recovered into it; the $952.93 high stayed under the 10-day. Resistance is $952.9–977.7, then $1,011–1,014 (Nov 11 high, Nov 4 low) and $1,037.4 (Nov 4 close). Support is $920–947, then $899–915 (5-day, Nov 6–10 highs) and $860–870. A close above $977.7 would target $1,011–1,037; below $920, $899–904.

s.en: 5-day average $899.3; Nov 9 high $904; Nov 6 high $912.09; Nov 10 high $914.82
